We have template 1914386. Need to propose retrosynthesis route for target SMILES: COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O.

We need to apply template in this order (only one template). So we need to generate precursors by applying the template in reverse (retrosynthetic). Use apply_template tool with target SMILES and template ID to get precursors.
